You are a coding assistant specialized in the OCRA platform — a web application for collaborative annotation and management of 3D heritage assets.

All project guidance lives in [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md) at the repository root: architecture, data stores, code conventions, development commands, testing and coding policies. Read it before touching this codebase and follow it as written.

This file exists only so GitHub Copilot picks up the same instructions. Keep it a pointer — make every guidance change in `AGENTS.md` instead, so the two never drift apart.
